svg.data-weight-note: 11.85 kg (26.12 lb), with 2 PSUs and 6 fans installed
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: datasheet: each port takes 1 x 400 GbE or breaks out to 2 x 200G / 4 x 100G, and also accepts 100 GbE QSFP28 and 40 GbE QSFP+. THE UPPER SIXTEEN PORTS SUPPORT UP TO 24 W PER TRANSCEIVER AND THE LOWER SIXTEEN DO NOT, which is a per-row fact this model has no vocabulary for and is recorded as a gap.
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: quick start, Port LEDs: 10G and 1G modes are both indicated, so the pair takes 10GbE and 1GbE optics.

rect.data-members: fan-1 fan-2 fan-3 fan-4 fan-5 fan-6
